### Admin booking-list rendering is not asserted

- **Changed surface:** The new `render()` function displays full booking records in `/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/blocks.js:84`.
- **Impacted consumer or site:** The “完整预约记录” section generated by `/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/templates/admin.html:59`.
- **Existing test evidence:** **Broken-verification gap.** `/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_maintenance_block_browser.cjs:41` queries bookings and checks response keys and response statuses. Its DOM assertions only require zero mutation buttons and zero injected HTML elements. Neither assertion requires a booking to appear. I also read the entire `/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/tests/test_blocks_js.cjs`; its successful record-rendering cases use block records. Repository searches for `blocks.js`, `admin-bookings-items`, and the shared rendering selectors identified no additional booking-rendering assertions.
- **Missing verification:** Assert that returned bookings actually render, including their title, purpose, owner, time interval, and cancellation details.
- **Demonstration:** Returning early from `render()` after clearing the list when `list.kind === "bookings"` would leave the booking section empty. The browser checks would still receive correct API responses, find zero buttons and injected elements, and encounter no JavaScript error. The JavaScript tests I read would still exercise only successful block rendering.
- **Consequence:** Administrators could receive a successful query response while seeing no booking records.
- **Disposition:** `patch` — extend the existing browser runner’s booking-list loop to compare rendered rows and fields with the returned booking records, including a cancelled record.

### Room-options refresh has no exercised verification path

- **Changed surface:** The refresh handler fetches rooms, replaces all three room selectors, preserves selections, and clears confirmation in `/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/blocks.js:160`.
- **Impacted consumer or site:** The “刷新会议室选项” button at `/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/templates/admin.html:42`, used to select a newly created room without leaving the management page.
- **Existing test evidence:** **Regression gap.** Repository-wide searches for `block-rooms-refresh`, `block-rooms-feedback`, and `blocks.js` found the handler, template, evidence files, and `/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/tests/test_blocks_js.cjs:21`, which only creates the refresh-button stub. I read that complete test file and the complete `/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_maintenance_block_browser.cjs`; neither invokes refresh. Searches of the existing room-management browser runner and tests found no refresh integration.
- **Missing verification:** Exercise refresh after creating a room and assert that the new room becomes selectable in the creation form and both filters, while existing draft values remain and confirmation resets.
- **Demonstration:** Omitting the option-append operation at `blocks.js:171` would make refresh remove the available rooms instead of updating them. None of the tests I read invokes this handler, so their assertions would remain unchanged.
- **Consequence:** The documented workflow for creating a maintenance block in a newly added room could stop working undetected.
- **Disposition:** `patch` — add this workflow to the existing maintenance-block browser runner, asserting actual option contents and preserved draft values after the click.
